paper_id: A Common Method of Share Authentication in Image Secret Sharing
title: A Common Method of Share Authentication in Image Secret Sharing
venue: IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems for Video Technology
motivation: 现有ISS方案中,参与者向未知方发送真实share时会被欺骗,导致真实share泄露
problem_framing: 设计(k,n)阈值的ISS,同时支持 dealer participatory 和 dealer nonparticipatory 认证,且满足无像素扩展、无辅助加密、无损解密
key_insight: 通过筛选操作(screening operation)使多项式份额的低4位XOR等于VSS加密的认证位,融合多项式ISS和无像素扩展VSS的优势
method_signature: 多项式ISS与(2,2)随机网格VSS融合,使用素域P=257,筛选系数满足XOR4LBs约束
evaluation_criteria: 对比度α、加密效率、解密复杂度、暴力攻击难度(NA≥4)、视觉可识别性
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 当n-k较大时需要更多迭代且N_A减少,建议(n-k)/n ≤ 1/2;认证依赖HVS视觉识别,无法定位篡改位置
evidence_for_taste: her real share is already sent to the fake participant
the dealer fails to decrypt and cannot distinguish the fake one
The advantages of VSS and polynomial-based ISS are skillfully fused
a screening operation is an operation that screens the polynomial coefficients satisfying some requirements
N_A ≥ 4 is suggested for an acceptable performance
may have failed authentication with a larger value of n-k
thinking_moves: 识别现有方案的安全漏洞:认证过程中真实share被暴露
将两种互补的ISS方法(多项式高质量+VSS简单解密)进行巧妙融合
用筛选操作作为融合机制,替代显式信息嵌入
在素域257而非251上工作以实现无损解密
将认证问题转化为VSS的视觉对比度问题,利用人眼感知
cites_own_work: Yan et al. 2020 (Secret image sharing with separate shadow authentication ability)
Jiang et al. 2020 (Secret image sharing with dealer-participatory and non-dealer-participatory)
